record.original_question: Assuming the ternary additive divisor conjecture, prove an omega theorem for the sixth moment I3(T) of the Riemann zeta function by showing that there exists Theta > 0 such that I3(T) = T P9(log T) + Omega(T^Theta), where P9 is a polynomial of degree 9.

evidence.quote: Is it possible to prove an omega theorem for I3 (T ) assuming the ternary additive divisor conjecture? Prove that there exists Θ > 0, such that I3 (T ) = T P9 (log T ) + Ω(T^Θ) where P9 is a certain degree nine polynomial.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For $T \geq 2$, define the sixth moment of the Riemann zeta function on the critical line by
$$I_3(T) = \int_0^T \left|\zeta\!\left(\tfrac{1}{2}+it\right)\right|^6 \, dt.$$
For positive integers $n$ let $d_3(n) = \sum_{abc=n} 1$ denote the ternary divisor function, and for a positive integer $h$ consider the ternary additive divisor sum
$$D_3(N,h) = \sum_{n \leq N} d_3(n)\, d_3(n+h).$$
The ternary additive divisor conjecture asserts that there exist a polynomial $Q_{h}(x)$ of degree $4$ in $x$ (with coefficients depending on $h$) and some $\delta > 0$ such that, uniformly in a suitable range of $h$,
$$D_3(N,h) = \int_1^N Q_h(\log u)\, du + O\!\left(N^{1-\delta}\right).$$

Assuming the ternary additive divisor conjecture, prove an omega theorem for $I_3(T)$: show that there exists a constant $\Theta > 0$ and a polynomial $P_9$ of degree $9$ such that
$$I_3(T) = T\, P_9(\log T) + \Omega\!\left(T^{\Theta}\right),$$
i.e. the error term $I_3(T) - T P_9(\log T)$ is not $o(T^\Theta)$ as $T \to \infty$.
artifact.category_tag: Moments of the Riemann zeta function
artifact.status_search_result: Conditional asymptotic formulas for the sixth moment $I_3(T) = T P_9(\log T) + O(T^{1-\delta})$ have been established under the ternary additive divisor conjecture (Ng, 2016; later refinements). However, an Omega-type lower bound for the error term $I_3(T) - T P_9(\log T)$ — analogous to the known omega theorems for the second and fourth moments — does not appear to have been proved, even conditionally. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The sixth moment of the Riemann zeta function and ternary additive divisor sums
status_evidence.snippet: A conjectural formula for a certain family of ternary additive divisor sums implies an asymptotic formula with power savings error term for the sixth moment of the Riemann zeta function on the critical line.
status_evidence.claim: Provides a conditional upper-bound-type asymptotic for I_3(T) under the ternary additive divisor conjecture, but does not establish an Omega result.

status_evidence.title: The sixth moment of the Riemann zeta function and ternary additive divisor sums (Discrete Analysis)
status_evidence.snippet: This work obtains a power-type improvement for the upper bound for I_3(T), conditional on the ternary additive divisor conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Conditional asymptotic results for I_3(T) exist; an Omega lower bound on the error term is not addressed.
